QuestInfo.name: [Year-End Event] Luck Sack Round-Up
QuestInfo.0: Get a Luck Sack from monsters before 2012 ends!
QuestInfo.1: Get a Luck Sack from monsters before 2012 ends! Hunt monsters that are no more than 11 levels above you and 21 levels below you.
QuestInfo.2: Hunt that are less than 11 levels above you and 21 levels below you to get a Luck Sack!

0.0: I cannot tell you how much paperwork comes along with the new year. There are quest log reports, boss rehabilitation requests... Spiegelmann sent over about two hundred 'gently used animals' to be stored in the back office. I need some luck to get through this. Do you think you can help?

no.0: You can stop pretending to be nice.

yes.0: Brilliant. I need a #i2430631# #r#t2430631##k, and I know there is at least one monster carrying one out there today. It's a monster tradition. I read that in my monster database. You'll find something fabulous in there if you keep looking. Just stick to monsters around your level range!

default.0: It's fate that we can't end our conversation.
